topic: Digital miner rewards are credited daily
hook: A GoMining digital miner pays out on a daily rhythm.

scenes.narration: Owners are credited daily bitcoin rewards.
A maintenance charge is taken off. It covers electricity and service costs.
What matters is the reward after that charge, not the headline reward alone.

cta: Do you check yours daily? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
title: How GoMining Digital Miner Rewards Are Credited
description_body: Rewards are credited daily, minus a maintenance charge for electricity and service.
